not_verifiable: The tobycarvery.co.uk menu page itself timed out in the headless browser, so the rendered page was not compared; the page loads this same JSON feed. The feed carries no ingredient lists (descriptions only), so allergen marks were checked against dish names and descriptions.
notes: Feed had drifted since 6 Oct (7 rows changed by sub-gram amounts, 0.2-2 kcal on 3 rows): script re-run on the fresh feed and data/source rebuilt. All 51 priced rows (7 nutrients + every contains/may-contain mark) re-read by an independent parse of the JSON: 0 differences. Held back (allergen row contradicts the dish name, as for Harvester/Stonehouse): Chocolate Fudge Cake (no gluten marked for a cake) and Toffee Apple Crumble (no gluten, no milk for a toffee crumble); noGlutenContainingIngs is false for both. Roast Turkey prints kJ 981 vs 322 kcal but its macros give 330 kcal; kJ is not published for this chain so it is kept (policy 1).
